emptyDeletionSetRationale: ARH1 changes contract bytes only: it introduces the dependency/visibility contracts and decides routes; implementation and deletion are bound to the named successors (ARH2 re-derives populations, ARH3/ARH4 narrow, ARH11 removes residue, ARH12 enforces). No existing API is superseded by a second authority at this node, so ARH1's own deletion set is empty; every row below binds a route to exactly one executing owner.

rows.disposition: physical deletion of the .gitignore-only placeholder lands together with the ARH0 inventory population refresh in the same change (the ARH0 verifier binds inventory rows to on-disk paths, so deletion and refresh cannot be separated); re-derivation of populations is ARH2's recorded obligation
rows.evidence: packages/core contains only a .gitignore reading 'generated' (no package.json, no sources, zero-LOC inventory row); it has no literal pnpm-workspace.yaml entry (covered only by the packages/* glob) and no importer; populating it would invent a package with no consumer

rows.decision: narrow the three public Scheduler bookkeeping fields (tombstones, generation_floors, deferred_blocker_ids) to pub(crate)
rows.disposition: visibility narrowing with zero external consumers; lands under the host/session lifecycle reduction heir after ARH2 characterization
rows.evidence: generation_floors and deferred_blocker_ids appear only inside crates/verter_scheduler; the tombstones hits in verter_session belong to SessionOverlayRoot (store_view_roots.rs), not Scheduler

rows.decision: move the fifteen test_* Scheduler hooks to test configuration (cfg(any(test, feature = "test-support")))
rows.disposition: test-seam gating with the exact per-hook consumer inventory recorded on the narrowing rows (nine verter_session files reference the hooks outside crates/verter_scheduler at ratification: host_construction.rs for test_worker_pool_ids, host_batch_coordinator.rs for test_new, four test-case files for test_with_executor, scheduler_audit_queue_dwell_under_load.rs for the pause/depth hooks, host_compile_atomic_upsert_tests.rs for the admit-epoch hooks, compile_style_vbind_source_snapshot_tests.rs for test_clear_analysis; six hooks have no consumer outside the owning crate); every recorded consumer migrates in the same change; lands under the host/session lifecycle reduction heir
rows.evidence: per-hook consumer populations derived from qualified reference forms (Scheduler::hook / .hook( receiver calls) in comment-stripped source; the owning crate's own cfg(test) modules (scheduler.rs, source_root_tests.rs) stay on cfg(test) and need no migration; corpus_audit_layout.rs calls the VerterHost wrapper, not the Scheduler hook

rows.decision: narrow every semantic_query pub item beyond the ten retained cross-crate envelope types and their seven used assoc items to pub(crate)
rows.disposition: bulk visibility narrowing; the cross-crate population (85 files: ffi/napi/wasm sources plus verter_session benches and integration tests, which compile as separate crates) is the exact importer inventory enforced by the verifier; the 68 files importing at least one narrowed name migrate to the existing for_tests test-support surface pattern in the same change, and PartialReasonSet::{empty,is_empty,iter,PROPAGATED,SEMANTIC_QUERY_FAULT}, ResultCompleteness::partial and ScopeId::file stay pub for the ffi/napi/wasm production consumers; lands under the semantic-dispatch narrowing heir after ARH2 characterization
rows.evidence: cross-crate references measured per consumer file from use-statement and inline-path syntax (aliases included, comments stripped): HashValue, SemanticNodeId, ScopeId, ResolveDeclKey, SemanticQueryKey, ResultCompleteness, PartialReason, PartialReasonSet, ProjectionMode, OriginEdgeKind are the only retained types imported, with the seven assoc items used on them; everything else referenced cross-crate is carried by a recorded bulk consumer
